values.note: Alpena County Parks: reservations open after January 2 for the coming season, with one night's deposit (two nights for holiday weekends). No refunds: deposits can be applied to a stay within a year; cancelling with under 7 days' notice costs a night, a no-show the full rental. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rentals also offered (seasonal bookings from September 1 for the next year).

booking.source: https://alpenacounty.org/292/Parks-Recreation ('Reservations are accepted after January 2 each year and require a deposit of one (1) night's stay ... Holiday weekends require a deposit of two (2) night's stay', 'Weekly and Monthly rentals are available', 'Seasonal reservations can be accepted after September 1st', no-refund/cancellation policy; Beaver Lake Park 'Online Reservations' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/beaver-lake-park), read 2026-10-22

summary: Alpena County's own pages (Parks & Recreation + Beaver Lake Park facility page) confirm the county runs it, Campspot online booking, phone 989-379-4462 (matches), and a May 15 - October 15 camping season (matches the stored 05-15 to 10-14 last night). Added the booking link and the county's reservation/deposit/cancellation terms. Fees, hookups, sites and facilities are not on the county pages; left as recorded (fees and hookups from Campspot 2026-10-13). Seasonal and monthly rentals exist, but Campspot sells nightly sites, so it is a transient campground.
